question: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Dweep is a part of which island?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andaman Islands**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Dweep** is part of the **Andaman Islands**, which are located in the **Bay of Bengal**.
 
• This island was earlier known as **Ross Island**. It was renamed as Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Dweep in **2018** to honor the Indian freedom fighter **Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose**.
 
• The Andaman Islands are a group of islands that belong to the Union Territory of **Andaman and Nicobar Islands** in India. *Hence, the correct option is Andaman Islands.*
 
• Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Dweep is a popular tourist destination. It is known for its rich **history**, serene **natural beauty**, and colonial-era ruins.
 
• The island holds historical significance as it was once the headquarters of the **British administration** in the Andaman Islands.
 
• The renaming of Ross Island to Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Dweep was part of an effort to commemorate the contributions of Netaji during India’s fight for independence. *Hence, the correct answer is Andaman Islands.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Andaman Islands:**

 
 
• The **Andaman Islands** are located in the southeastern part of the **Bay of Bengal**, closer to Myanmar and Thailand than mainland India.
 
• The islands are known for their **pristine beaches**, dense tropical **forests**, and vibrant **marine biodiversity**.
 
• The Andaman Islands are home to indigenous tribes such as the **Great Andamanese**, **Onges**, and **Sentinelese**.
 
 
 
• **Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose:**
 
 
• Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose was one of India's most prominent freedom fighters and the leader of the **Indian National Army (INA)**.
 
• He played a critical role in the **Independence movement** and attempted to liberate India from British rule through military campaigns.
 
• He is remembered for his famous slogan, "**Give me blood, and I will give you freedom**."
 
 
 
• **Tourist Attractions in Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Dweep:**
 
 
• Visitors can explore the **British-era ruins**, including administrative offices, churches, and residences.
 
• The island offers picturesque views and is surrounded by clear waters ideal for **snorkeling** and **scuba diving**.
 
• The light and sound show organized on the island narrates its **colonial history** and Netaji's contributions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Renaming of Islands:**

 
 
• In **2018**, the Indian government renamed three islands in the Andaman archipelago:
 
• **Ross Island** became **Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Dweep**.
 
• **Neil Island** was renamed **Shaheed Dweep**.
 
• **Havelock Island** was renamed **Swaraj Dweep**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Renaming:**
 
 
• These renaming efforts aimed to honor the contributions of freedom fighters and instill a sense of **national pride**.
 
• They also sought to remove colonial-era names and replace them with names that reflect India’s **rich history** and **struggle for independence**.
